verdict.rationale: Quo's own marketing documents that teammates can share one number ("Share one number and stay aligned with your team"), and call routing and ring orders support team handling of that number. However, nothing in the evidence documents teammate presence/availability, assigning conversations to teammates, or internal comment threads. missing for 10: teammate presence indicators, conversation assignment, internal threads/notes on conversations, in-depth docs on shared-number setup, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a support leader, several teammates share one number with presence, conversation assignment, and internal threads
